source.policy: Platinum daytime regular grass: Starly 40%, Bidoof 60%, levels 2-3. Morning/night Kricketot, swarm, Poke Radar and dual-slot encounters are omitted by the runtime day-only policy.
Platinum daytime regular grass: Bidoof 50%, Starly 30%, Shinx 20%. Morning/night Kricketot and special encounter methods are omitted by the runtime day-only policy.

Platinum daytime regular grass: Starly 35%, Bidoof 25%, Shinx 25%, Abra 15%, levels 4-7 with original species-specific level slots. Morning/night substitutions, swarm, Poke Radar, GBA insertion, Surf and fishing are omitted by the runtime day-only walking policy.

Pokemon Platinum Oreburgh Gate 1F standard cave encounters: Zubat 50% levels 5-8, Psyduck 35% levels 5-7, Geodude 15% levels 5 and 7. B1F, Surf, fishing, items and Rock Smash progression are excluded.

Pokemon Platinum Oreburgh Mine upper explorable floor: Geodude 65% levels 5-8, Zubat 25% levels 5-7, Onix 10% levels 6-9, taken from Serebii Pokearth 1F which Bulbapedia labels B1F. The project has a single mine floor, so the deeper floor roster, Rock Smash progression, the original two Worker trainers, floor items and the Roark discovery scene are excluded. Bulbapedia lists Geodude 4-8 and Onix 6,8 for the same floor; the Serebii Platinum ranges are used and the difference is recorded.

B2W2 regular grass includes Minccino at levels 21-24. Runtime exposes the supported Minccino subset only; Liepard, Trubbish and version-exclusive Gothita/Solosis remain omitted, so this is not the complete original table.
B2W2 flying Pokemon shadows yield Ducklett at levels 23-26. Runtime keeps the species and encounter method but caps the authored range at level 25; feather drops are not implemented.

HGSS 1F walking includes Zubat Lv26-28. Supported subset only: Zubat; project Lv22-24 and optional side corridors, not original weights or full roster. Checked 2026-09-13. No Surf, radio or legendary.

B2W2 Castelia habitat evidence, not a reproduction of its original access route. Project northern city garden placement, levels 22-24 and weights 60/40. Pidove and Petilil only; no sewer, season, Surf, story gate or evolution implied.

Day walking habitat reference using the currently supported Meowth and Pidgey. Levels 23-25 and weights 55/45 are project tuning for the level-25 travel party, not original version rates. Encounters are limited to optional garden-edge grass while the marked Celadon-Saffron road remains safe. Vulpix, Oddish, Growlithe, version choice, night, items and story locks are excluded.

Day walking habitat reference using the currently supported Pidgey, Spearow and Ekans. Levels 23-25 and weights 45/35/20 are project tuning for the level-25 travel party, not original version rates. Encounters are limited to optional outer grass while the marked Saffron-Lavender road and Underground Path remain safe. Vulpix, Oddish, Meowth, Growlithe, version choice, night, items and story locks are excluded.

Species habitat reference only. Project levels 22-24 and weights 40/60 support the existing level-25 travel party. Initial supported subset: Rattata and Drowzee. Abra and Ditto are not claimed as implemented here. No radio, time, Surf or fishing unlocks.

Cinnabar regional species reference from authored ENC-035 (FireRed Mansion records 31417 and 31419). Project outdoor habitat adaptation, not an original Mansion encounter or an implemented Mansion map. Levels 22-24 and weights 60/40 are project tuning for the level-25 cap. Two optional outskirts grass patches only; no sea encounters, story locks or gifts. Koffing and Magmar remain excluded.

Day walking habitat reference with a supported-species project subset. Rattata and Spearow are shared day references; Ekans represents the SoulSilver side. Hoppip and Zubat are excluded from this day-only runtime subset. Levels 22-24 and weights 50/30/20 are project tuning for the existing level-25 travel party. No rain battle rule, radio, headbutt, fishing, gift or story lock is implied.

1F cave walking habitat reference with the currently supported Zubat, Geodude and Onix only. Levels 23-25 and weights 45/45/10 are project tuning for the existing level-25 travel party. Sandshrew is not yet in the runtime roster. No Surf, fishing, B1F, B2F, Friday encounter or story lock is implied.

Day walking habitat reference with a supported-species project subset. Rattata represents HeartGold and SoulSilver while Ekans represents the SoulSilver side. Bellsprout, Mareep and Hoppip are not yet in the runtime roster. Levels 23-25 and weights 70/30 are project tuning for the existing level-25 travel party. No version choice, radio, night, Surf, fishing, swarm, gift or story lock is implied.

Day walking habitat reference with the currently supported Rattata, Spearow and Ekans only. Levels 22-24 and weights 45/35/20 are project tuning for the level-25 travel party, not original rates. Sandshrew and version selection are excluded. Optional grass branches only; no item, trainer, Surf or story lock is implied.

Route 10 north and south share a supported day-walking project pool of Rattata, Spearow and Ekans. Levels 23-25 and weights 40/35/25 are project tuning, not original rates. Optional grass branches only. Power Plant water, fishing, Surf, version selection and story gates remain unavailable.

Rock Tunnel cave habitat reference using supported Zubat, Geodude, Machop and Onix. Levels 23-25 and weights 40/35/15/10 are project tuning. Encounters are limited to B1F optional echo loops so the marked main passage remains safe. No Flash requirement, item, fixed encounter or story gate is implied.

Combined HeartGold and SoulSilver daytime walking habitat using the currently supported Caterpie, Metapod, Weedle, Kakuna and Zubat. Paras is not yet in the runtime roster. Levels 22-24 and weights 30/17/30/18/5 are project tuning for the existing travel party, not original rates. Encounters use optional southern-loop grass while the marked main road remains safe. No version choice, night, radio, Headbutt, Surf, fishing, gift, Farfetchd puzzle, shrine event or story lock is implied.

B2W2 normal-grass habitat reference using Marill, Karrablast and Shelmet. Levels 23-25 and weights 35/35/30 are project tuning for the level-25 travel cap, not original levels or version rates. Encounters are limited to two optional grass loops while the marked east-west road remains safe. Dark grass, rustling grass, Surf, fishing, Virizion, freezing events, items and story locks are excluded.

Day walking habitat reference using the currently supported Rattata and Drowzee only. Levels 23-25 and weights 45/55 are project tuning for the level-25 travel cap. Nidoran, Abra, Ditto and Yanma are not claimed as implemented. Encounters use optional side grass while the Goldenrod-Park road remains safe. No radio, swarm, time event, item or story lock is implied.

Free-walk daytime habitat reference using supported Caterpie, Metapod, Weedle, Kakuna and Pidgey. Levels 22-25 and weights are project tuning, not Bug-Catching Contest rates. Optional flower-bed grass only; the loop path stays safe. The contest, ranking, timer, prizes, Sunkern, version choice, night and radio encounters remain unavailable.

Day walking habitat reference using supported Rattata and Pidgey only. Levels 23-25 and weights 55/45 are project tuning. Optional branch grass leaves all three junction roads safe. Bellsprout, Growlithe, Vulpix, Hoothoot and Stantler, the Sudowoodo event, watering item, radio, night and story locks are excluded.

Day walking habitat reference using supported Rattata and Pidgey only. Levels 24-25 and weights 45/55 are project tuning for the Ecruteak approach. Optional apricorn-grove grass keeps the central road safe. Growlithe, Vulpix, Hoothoot and Stantler, apricorn rewards, radio, night, items and story locks are excluded.

Day walking habitat reconstruction using currently supported Rattata plus Pidgey as a general Johto grassland companion. Levels 24-25 and weights 55/45 are project tuning. Optional pasture grass leaves the east-west road safe. Raticate, Meowth, Persian, Magnemite, Farfetch'd, Tauros and Miltank are not claimed as implemented; radio, night, items and story locks are excluded.

Day walking habitat reconstruction using currently supported Rattata plus Pidgey as a general Johto coastal grassland companion. Levels 24-25 and weights 45/55 are project tuning. Optional fence-side grass keeps the north-south road and farm branch safe. Unsupported original species, radio, night, farm gifts, items and story locks are excluded.

Generation III grass habitat reference using currently supported Rattata and Spearow only. Levels 24-25 and weights 45/55 are project tuning for the level-25 travel cap, not original rates. Encounters stay in optional side grass while the marked north-south road remains safe. Raticate, Fearow and Doduo, forced downhill movement, Bicycle locks, Surf, fishing, items and story locks are excluded.

Generation III grass habitat reference using currently supported Spearow and Rattata only. Levels 24-25 and weights 60/40 are project tuning for the level-25 travel cap, not original rates. Encounters stay in the optional Fuchsia-side grass and southern loops while the east-west road remains safe. Raticate, Fearow and Doduo, gate trades, Bicycle locks, fishing, items and story locks are excluded.

Generation III grass habitat reference using currently supported Rattata and Spearow only. Levels 24-25 and equal project weights support the level-25 travel cap and are not original rates. Encounters stay in optional side grass while the marked Celadon-to-Route-17 road remains safe. Raticate and Doduo, the Snorlax event, Cut, Fly rewards, Bicycle locks, items and story locks are excluded.

Combined Black 2 and White 2 puddle habitat using currently supported Karrablast and Shelmet only. Levels 24-25 and equal weights are project tuning for the existing level-25 travel cap, not original levels or version rates. Encounters stay in two optional wet-grass loops while the marked Icirrus-to-Tubeline road remains safe. Croagunk, Palpitoad and Stunfisk, winter freezing, Surf, fishing, swarms, gifts, items and story locks are excluded.

HeartGold and SoulSilver daytime walking habitat using supported Pidgeotto only. Levels 24-25 and the single-species runtime weight are project tuning for the existing level-25 travel cap, not original rates. Encounters stay in two optional western grass stretches while the shorter eastern old-gate path remains grass-free. Venonat, Noctowl, Mareep, Flaaffy and Girafarig, radio, night, Surf, fishing, Headbutt, items, the toll gate and story locks are excluded.

HeartGold and SoulSilver walking grass habitat using exact supported Tangela only. Levels 23-25 and the single-species weight are project tuning for the level-25 travel cap, not original rates. Encounters stay in the optional pond-side grass while the west-east road remains safe. Bellsprout, Weepinbell and Lickitung, Surf, fishing, Headbutt, radio, swarm, items and story locks are excluded.

HeartGold and SoulSilver cave habitat using exact supported Zubat only across the four implemented floors. Levels 22-24 and the single-species weight are project tuning for the level-25 travel cap, not original rates or floor-specific rates. Encounters use optional frosted side strips on every floor while a dry-rock bypass remains available between each pair of stairs. Golbat, Jynx, Swinub and Delibird, items, Waterfall HM, forced sliding, boulder puzzles and story locks are excluded.

HeartGold and SoulSilver mountain-road walking habitat using exact supported Geodude only. Levels 23-25 and the single-species runtime weight are project tuning for the level-25 travel cap, not original rates. Encounters stay in optional branch grass while the north-south route and east return climbs remain safe. Graveler, Gligar, Teddiursa, Skarmory, Phanpy and Donphan, Dark Cave, Surf, fishing, items, phone rematches and story locks are excluded.

HeartGold and SoulSilver walking habitat using exact supported Rattata, Spearow and Geodude. Levels 22-24 are project tuning for the current southbound Blackthorn travel party rather than the original early-route levels; weights retain the original daytime 25/35/40 proportions. Encounters stay in optional branch grass while the marked route and east return climb remain safe. Headbutt, radio encounters, Dark Cave, items, gifts, rematches and story locks are excluded.

FireRed and LeafGreen walking grass habitat using exact supported Pidgey only. Levels 24-25 and the single-species weight are project tuning for the level-25 travel cap, not original rates. Encounters stay in three optional side grass areas while the marked west-east road remains safe. Oddish, Gloom, Venonat, Bellsprout, Weepinbell and Ditto, version differences, items, gate rewards and story locks are excluded.

FireRed and LeafGreen walking grass habitat using exact supported Pidgey and Pidgeotto only. Levels 24-25 and 70/30 weights are project tuning for the existing level-25 travel cap, not original levels or rates. Encounters stay in three optional side grass loops while the marked south-north road remains safe. Oddish, Gloom, Venonat, Bellsprout, Weepinbell and Ditto, version differences, items, Cut branches and story locks are excluded.

FireRed and LeafGreen walking grass habitat using exact supported Pidgey and Pidgeotto only. Levels 24-25 and 80/20 weights are project tuning for the existing level-25 travel cap, not original levels or rates. Encounters stay in the single optional northeast grass patch while the marked west-east fence-maze road remains safe. Oddish, Gloom, Venonat, Bellsprout, Weepinbell and Ditto, version differences, Surf, fishing, items, Cut access and story locks are excluded.

Platinum northern Route 210 day walking habitat using the currently supported Meditite and Machop only. Levels 20-22 and weights 55/45 are project tuning for the current Celestic travel party, not original levels or rates. Encounters stay in one optional fog-grove grass patch while the marked Celestic-southbound road remains safe. Swablu, Bibarel, Machoke, Scyther, time variants, Surf, fishing, Poke Radar, items and story locks are excluded.

HGSS day walking supported subset: Pidgey and Rattata. Sentret is unsupported and excluded. Levels 20-22 and weights 80/20 are project tuning for the current Johto party, not original rates or levels. Only the optional northwest hill has encounters; the main road stays safe. No night, radio, Headbutt, gifts or capture locks.

B2W2 standard walking habitat using Minccino, the only currently supported original normal-grass species. Levels 24-25 are project tuning for the level-25 travel cap. Encounters are limited to optional southern grass patches while the paved east-west road remains safe. Version-exclusive Gothorita or Duosion, Garbodor, Pawniard, Liepard, Muk, dark grass, rustling grass, swarms, Hidden Grotto, items, Challenger's Cave and the Plasma freeze event are excluded.

HGSS daytime HeartGold and SoulSilver walking tables combined for the supported Pidgey, Caterpie, Metapod, Weedle and Kakuna. Version-exclusive bugs are both available as a Nexus project blend. Levels 20-23 are project tuning for the current Johto party, not original levels 2-4. Encounters occur only in optional side grass; the marked central route remains safe. No night, radio, Headbutt, Surf, fishing, gifts, Apricorn Box, Mystery Egg or story lock.

HGSS daytime HeartGold and SoulSilver walking tables combined for supported Pidgey, Caterpie, Metapod, Weedle and Kakuna. Bellsprout is part of the original table but unsupported by the current runtime and excluded. Levels 21-23 are project tuning rather than original levels 3-5. Encounters stay in optional side grass while the Route 30 to Violet path remains safe. No night, radio, Headbutt, Surf, fishing, Dark Cave interior, mail delivery, gifts, items or story lock.

HGSS Route 31-side standard walking habitat. Supported Geodude and Zubat retain the original 60/39 relative weights; unsupported Dunsparce at the original 1 percent is documented and excluded rather than replaced. Levels 22-24 are Nexus tuning for the current level-25 travel cap, not the original levels 2-4. Encounters occur only on optional loose-rock strips around a marked safe survey loop. Surfing, fishing, radio, swarm, Rock Smash encounters, items, field-move locks and the Route 45/46 through-route are excluded.

HGSS Route 45-side standard walking habitat. Current runtime supports only Zubat and Geodude from the original Zubat30, Golbat5, Geodude30, Graveler20 and Wobbuffet15 table, so the two supported equal original weights are normalized to 50/50; unsupported species are documented and not replaced. Levels 23-25 preserve the original late-route band within the project level cap. Encounters stay on optional rough shelves in both return pockets. Surfing, fishing, radio encounters, items, gifts, field-move locks and through-travel between Route 45, Route 46 and the Route 31 side are excluded.

source.note: Supported subset of B2 puddle encounters: Shelmet20/Karrablast5 normalized to80/20. Level23-24 and dry-bank grass are project adaptations. No winter/surf/fishing simulation.

source.policy: Northern 1F Pt day includes Zubat, Machop, Geodude, Meditite. Project supported subset with custom weights 10/20/40/30 and Lv16-18, optional rock shelf only; not full original encounter table.
B1F standard walking Seel30% Lv32-34, Zubat10% Lv28-29. Supported subset normalized75/25; project Lv23-24, optional corridor, other species omitted.
HGSS B2F standard walking Seel30% Lv33-35 and Zubat10% Lv29-30. Supported subset normalized75/25; project Lv24-25 on optional rock loop. Golbat/Psyduck/Golduck omitted; not original full table.

HGSS B3F walking includes Golbat30%, Dewgong24%, Golduck14%, Psyduck12%, Zubat10% and Seel10%. Supported subset Seel/Zubat is normalized50/50; project Lv24-25 on the optional winding cold-rock corridor. Other species, Surf/fishing, radio encounters, items, HM puzzles and Articuno are excluded.

HGSS B4F walking includes Golbat30%, Dewgong24%, Golduck14%, Jynx12%, Psyduck10% and Seel10%. The supported subset is Seel100%; project Lv24-25 appears only on optional cold-rock shelves beside a continuous safe route. Other species, Surf/fishing, items, HM puzzles and Articuno are excluded.
Pt day west original species weights retained; source per-species Lv13-16 simplified to common project Lv14-16.

Pt day east supported unevolved subset; omitted Graveler20% Lv28 and Machoke15% Lv29-30 exceed current growth scope. Relative weights40:15:10 normalized by runtime; source Lv27-30 adjusted to project Lv23-25.

B2W2 walking table checked 2026-09-13: Rattata 45%, Zubat 45%, Grimer 10%. Grimer uses discrete levels 15 and 17; other species use 14-17. Dry walking only; no Surf, season or Hugh double battles. Map binding pending regional integration.

White 2 regular grass table checked 2026-09-13. Species, relative weights and discrete species levels retained. No dark-grass double battles, shaking grass, season or gift Eevee. Separate from project northern U01-GARDEN. Map binding pending.

Black 2 regular-grass supported subset: Karrablast 5% and Shelmet 25%, normalized to 17/83. Source Lv26 is capped at project Lv25. Deerling, Marill, Tranquill, Swadloon, Foongus, dark/rustling grass, Surf and fishing are excluded. Encounters occur only in two optional side patches; the central bridges and road remain safe.

B2W2 1F cave table subset keeps Nosepass10, Joltik39, Ferroseed20 and Klink24 relative weights, normalized by runtime. Original Lv25-28 is adapted to project Lv24-25. Boldore and Tynamo, dust clouds, held items and Memory Link encounters are excluded. Encounter crystal fields are off the direct stair route.

B2W2 B1F cave table subset keeps Nosepass10, Joltik39, Ferroseed20 and Klink24 relative weights, normalized by runtime. All original Lv28-31 are capped at project Lv25. Boldore and Tynamo, dust clouds, held items and deeper B2F encounters are excluded. Encounter crystal fields sit outside the one-cell magnetic-crystal gate.

Black 2 regular-grass supported subset: Skorupi30 and Trapinch15 normalized to 67/33. Original Lv31-34 is capped at project Lv24-25. Spoink, Grumpig, Drifblim, Skarmory, dark/rustling grass and swarms are excluded. Two optional ash-grass branches leave the direct Lentimas-to-cave route safe.

Black 2 entrance cave supported subset keeps Spoink20, Skorupi15, Boldore25 and Woobat35 relative weights; runtime normalizes the listed values. Original Lv31-35 is capped at project Lv24-25. Grumpig, dust clouds and version-exclusive Numel/Camerupt are excluded. Encounter shelves are off the direct passage.

Black 2 main-cavern supported subset keeps Spoink5, Skorupi15, Boldore25 and Woobat35 relative weights; runtime normalizes the listed values. Original Lv31-35 is capped at project Lv24-25. Grumpig, dust clouds, Bianca double battles and Heatran are excluded because shared partner/double/special encounter contracts are not implemented. Side shelves leave the Undella passage safe.

B2W2 regular-grass supported subset keeps Tangela25 and Pelipper25, normalized to equal weights. Original Lv34-37 is capped at project Lv24-25. Lunatone, Solrock, Absol, Drifblim, dark/rustling grass, water encounters, swarms, Hidden Grottoes and Cobalion are excluded. Four side grass patches preserve a safe central route between Undella and Lacunosa.

B2W2 regular-grass supported subset keeps Roselia25, Combee20 and Tranquill25 relative weights; runtime normalizes the listed values. Original Lv35-38 is capped at project Lv24-25. Black 2 Pinsir, White 2 Heracross, Sewaddle, dark/rustling grass, swarms and special encounters are excluded. Two side grass patches preserve the lower safe path between Lacunosa and Village Bridge.
